how_it_works.title: How to Compress PDF Files Online
steps: Select the PDF document you want to compress from your computer or mobile device.
Adjust the compression level between 'Recommended' (best quality) or 'Extreme' (smallest size) to shrink your PDF file size.
Wait a moment for our secure browser-based tool to compress the PDF locally without any server uploads.
Instantly download and save your optimized, smaller PDF document once the process is complete.

items.q: How to compress PDF files without uploading them?
items.a: SafeTools uses WebAssembly technology to process your files directly in your browser. This means your PDF never leaves your computer, providing the most secure way to shrink PDF size.

items.q: Is this PDF compressor free to use?
items.a: Yes, our PDF compression tool is completely free. You can reduce PDF size as many times as you want without any hidden costs or subscriptions.

items.q: Does compressing a PDF reduce its quality?
items.a: Our 'Recommended' mode uses intelligent optimization to reduce file size while maintaining visual quality. The 'Extreme' mode provides maximum compression by slightly reducing image resolution, ideal for email attachments.

items.q: What is the maximum file size I can compress?
items.a: Since processing happens in your browser's memory, we recommend files up to 100MB for the best experience, though larger files may work depending on your device's RAM.

items.q: Are my documents safe with SafeTools?
items.a: Absolutely. Privacy is our core mission. Unlike other online converters, we do not have a backend server that stores your files. Everything is processed in a secure local sandbox.
